text:
Mira: Heads-up — onboarding sample app spiked in prod this morning. Users hit 429s repeatedly during initial page load.
Mira: This is the React sample app that does a prefetch of 10 pages in parallel (to speed up UX).
Mira: Error looks like: 429 Too Many Requests, Retry-After: 5
Sam (sdk): Oof. Which SDK version? We recently changed client prefetch concurrency defaults in the Python SDK (v1.6.0) but not in JS.
Mira: App running with python-sdksdk v1.6.0 in the backend and web uses js-sdk v1.3.2.
Mira: The backend prefetch kicks off 8 parallel embed/tokenize calls plus pagination cursors. When tokens refresh happens, we get a retry storm.
Tanner (infra): Can you paste the rate-limit headers from one request? We added a new header last week to help clients: X-RI-Quota: 120/60 (remaining/period) and X-RI-Reset: 168s
Mira: Sample header: X-RI-Quota: 3/60, X-RI-Reset: 55, Retry-After: 5
Joan (eng-oncall): So low quota on that account (free trial) + parallel prefetch = thundering herd. Also token refreshs overlap?
Mira: Yeah — the SDK's auth refresh is non-deduplicated: three threads see expired token, all try refresh, and then re-run requests concurrently.
Sam (sdk): That's the key parity bug. JS SDK coalesces auth refresh, Python SDK does not. Parity gap.
Sam (sdk): Also Python SDK's default prefetch window is 8 parallel requests; JS is 3. I think both defaults should be conservative for trial accounts.
Joan (eng-oncall): For immediate mitigation we should: 1) server-side: raise soft-limit on trial to avoid total block for a short window, 2) client-side: backoff + auth dedupe fix.
Tanner (infra): Server-side increasing short-term isn't ideal (we want quotas enforced), but we can add a small smoothing token-bucket at the edge for UI-origin bursts. Temporary.
Mira: Users saw a mix of 429 and 401 during the storm — because some requests tried with an expired token and then retried without waiting for refresh.
Sam (sdk): Action: I'll ship a hotfix to python-sdk to dedupe auth refresh (mutex per credential) and reduce default prefetch concurrency to 3 for new installs. Patch will also honor Retry-After header before retrying.
Sam (sdk): Proposed PR diff snippet:
```
# pseudocode
if token_expired():
  if refresh_in_progress():
    wait_for_refresh()
  else:
    acquire_refresh_lock()
    refresh_token()
    release_refresh_lock()
# Respect Retry-After on 429
on_429(resp):
  retry_after = resp.headers.get('Retry-After')
  sleep(max(base_backoff * 2**attempt, int(retry_after or 0)))
```
Tanner (infra): Also please make SDK parse X-RI-Quota so it can switch to a conservative mode when remaining < 5 (e.g., limit concurrency to 1-2). We'll document the header soon.
Joan (eng-oncall): I'll add an incident postmortem note. Short-term rollout: toggle client-side prefetch to off in the sample app, push new SDK patch, and notify trial bucket.
Mira: For onboarding docs — we should add guidance: "If you're on trial or low quota plan, set PREFETCH_CONCURRENCY=1 and enable auth dedupe".
Sam (sdk): I'll add a compatibility shim so older SDKs log a warning when X-RI-Quota header indicates tight quota.
Mira: Any risk of double-billing from the retries? Ops?
Tanner (infra): Billing uses accepted tokens on success; duplicates could increase token usage counts if requests succeed multiple times. We should add idempotency keys for prefetch calls where possible.
Joan (eng-oncall): Task list: - Mira: flip sampleapp env var to PREFETCH_CONCURRENCY=1 (done?) - Sam: PR for auth dedupe + default concurrency change (ETA 6h) - Tanner: edge smoothing config for trial bucket (ETA 2h) - Joan: incident note + user comms (ETA 3h)
Mira: Flipped sampleapp var to 1 and redeployed to staging. Staging looks stable. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: deploy-stage succeeded for sampleapp/staging @ 2025-11-18T09:02:10Z
Sam (sdk): I'll open the PR and request reviews from @Tanner and @Joan.
Mira: Thanks all — let's sync after PR lands and then push a patch release.
Joan (eng-oncall): Postmortem draft will include links to SDK PR, edge header docs, and sampleapp env change.
Sam (sdk): Note for follow-up: add tests for concurrent refresh + integration test for 429 header handling (simulate X-RI-Quota low).
Mira: Great — closing the loop here. If anyone sees residual 429s after the rollout ping this thread.
